notes: Bucket numbers stay on the cards. bucket_pools is pools 1-5 (b1 through b5): a pool unlocks with that biome, and once unlocked its items and monsters may appear in any biome. Cabinets still credit the card's pool, not the delve you found it in. Each biome deals exactly 10 monsters at the locked Weak/Tough/Deadly mix (6/3/1, 5/3/2, 4/4/2, 3/5/2, 3/4/3). A Deadly monster is not dealt again anywhere in the same campaign save. Later monster-entry loot still follows that monster's rank; only the opening six offers use starter_item_mix. The 3-unique start gate counts toward the Cellar cabinet of 5.
